body.name: Minimax-rate-gap handle
body.construction: The handle \(H\) uses \(\widehat U^{\mathrm H}\) and \(1\wedge a^{\mathrm{loose}}_{nm}\) for the constant upper endpoint in loss \(\mathcal L\), and the constant-propensity row packing for the \(b_{nm}\) lower endpoint.  It searches over \(\mathfrak E_{n,m}\) for either a smaller uniform risk or an estimator-independent adaptive lower construction preserving \(\mathbb G\).  Only after this rate gap closes does it derive a local likelihood experiment for \(C_\star\).
inputs: The hybrid upper bound and constant-propensity packing.
